name: DCA Paradise Garden Grill Seasonal Grilled Chicken / Steak Plate with Steamed White Rice & Tortillas (Plain Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Paradise Garden Grill (Paradise Gardens Park · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Paradise Garden Grill rotates seasonal menus (Plaza de la Familia, Lunar New Year, Festival of Holidays) but consistently keeps plain steamed white rice, warm flour/corn tortillas, and grilled chicken or steak on the line (especially on the Kids' menu).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Kids' Grilled Chicken or Steak Taco/Skewer Plate with plain steamed white rice—or ask for the adult grilled protein with all mole/chili/citrus sauces on the side and no beans.
watchOuts: Skip Al Pastor (marinated in chili & pineapple) and dark mole sauces (contain nuts, seeds, and chilies)
